added_lines: The potential of AI agents is powerful, but trust is what turns potential into real-world impact.
on building confidence to put AI to work. Learn more below.  👇
Would you bet your job on your company's AI agents?
World 2026, I heard a fascinating story. Almost every executive had an AI pilot. But when asked if they would bet their job on its success, most hands went down.
That says a lot about where we are with AI today.
I spent the day talking with executives, meeting the teams behind the technology, and testing AI agents myself.
What I discovered surprised me. From a hospital turning a 12 month project into 8 weeks, to a company deliberately limiting its AI autonomy, even when it could do more.
The biggest lesson? The future of AI isn't just about what agents can do. It's about what we can trust them to do.
Curious to hear which story surprises you most. 👇
